is_sga_total.zh-TW: 利息不是為了賣文具而發生的開支，所以不在銷管費用裡。
is_sga_total.en: Interest is not a cost of selling stationery, so it is not among distribution costs and administrative expenses.

is_non_operating_expense_total.zh-TW: 很接近了：這是營業外支出的小計，利息費用是它上面的明細列。
is_non_operating_expense_total.en: Very close: this is the subtotal of non-operating expenses; interest expense is the detail line above it.

prompt.zh-TW: 日暮文具社這一期付了銀行利息。請在損益表上點出利息費用出現的那一列。
prompt.en: Sunset Stationery paid bank interest this period. Tap the line on the income statement where interest expense appears.

explanation.zh-TW: 利息是借錢的代價，和本業無關，所以放在營業外支出底下。它在營業利益之後才扣，不會影響營業利益。
explanation.en: Interest is the price of borrowing and unrelated to the core business, so it sits under non-operating expenses. It is deducted after operating profit and does not affect it.
